# PUT /api/v1/orgs/{org}/blocks/{username}

Block a user from the organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-089`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |
| note | query | string | False |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Cannot block user (self-block, org member, already blocked, or target is org)

- **422** — Validation error

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot block an organization (only individual users) | business_logic | blockee.IsOrganization() |
| Cannot block self or the doer themselves | authorization | blocker.ID == blockee.ID || doer.ID == blockee.ID |
| Cannot block a user who is already blocked | authorization | user_model.IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, blockee, blocker.ID) |
| Cannot block an org member; doer must be org admin | authorization | blocker.IsOrganization() && blockee is org member |
| Blocking removes all mutual relationships in a single transaction | business_logic | Block is permitted |
